explicit_validation.explanation: Paper explicitly validates LLM evaluation against human evaluation by randomly selecting 50 samples for human evaluation and calculating Pearson Correlation Coefficient between consistency scores from human annotators and Llama-3-70B

prompts.notes: Prompt template mentioned in appendix but exact text not fully provided; evaluation method adopted from recent research using LLM as evaluator

guidelines.notes: Detailed criteria provided for motivation recognition question filtering, including character decision requirements, motivation focus, meaningful context, and prohibition of motivation leakage

sample_size.notes: Randomly selected 50 samples used for validation

validation_results.summary_finding: Llama-3-70B evaluation shows significant correlation (Pearson r=0.752, p<0.001) with human judgments on factual consistency assessment, validating LLM evaluation capabilities for this task.

criteria_mapping.notes: Both LLM and human evaluate factual consistency; LLM also evaluates motivation recognition task performance; human evaluators also filter motivation recognition questions
